english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a fanciful idea or imagined possibility.
Use this when the imagination refers to a fantasy or a false idea rather than a mental ability.

examples.english: I often have a fantasy about travelling around the world after winning the lottery.
examples.traditional: 我成日幻想自己中獎之後環遊世界。
